Mythic+ Rating tracks a player's progress through Mythic+ dungeons of increasing difficulty by scoring their best performances in each dungeon on Fortified and Tyrannical (affix) affixes. Every keystone level has a hidden base score, the number of points awarded if it were completed exactly on time. +2 begins at 40 score, and each higher key adds 5. Additionally, +4 and +7 are worth double and +10 is worth triple. Completing the dungeon faster yields a small increase, not exceeding the jump to a higher level. Nagrand ("Land of Winds" in orcish) is a zone located in Outland. It lies south of Zangarmarsh, west of Terokkar Forest, and southwest of Hellfire Peninsula. It is the last remaining unscarred region of Outland. In the center of the zone is the neutral town of Halaa, which can be captured by either faction. Whoever holds it will have access to a mass of amenities including active quest givers, NPCs who accept turn-ins acquired from the zone's monsters, vendors, trainers, and the like. The opposing faction, naturally, is locked out of all this, which is precisely why they will be laying siege to it around the clock. See the World PvP section below for more information.

The naaru (pronounced ) are a race of living, sentient energy beings made up of scintillating holy energies. They are perhaps the purest expression of the Holy Light that exists in the Great Dark Beyond, and have vowed to bring peace and hope to all mortal civilizations and waylay the forces of the Void. They are known to travel through dimensions, and are the sworn enemies of the Burning Legion. Not all naaru necessarily have the same motives, and they have their own personalities and own goals, with Xe'ra, who was notably different from other naaru players have met, being the best example of this. A Name Change is a paid service that allows players to choose a new name for a character. The Name Change is also included with the Appearance Change, Race Change, and Faction Change services, but can be purchased separately. This service is also available to Classic branch characters. Other players on the same realm will be unable to use the old name for 90 days. The player that changed the name will be able to use it otherwise. The Naglfar (sometimes called the ship of the dead or the dread ship) is a fearsome ship, formed from sinew and bone and crewed by kvaldir, which ferries damned vrykul souls from the world of the living across the Maw of Souls to Helheim and the clutches of Helya. Skjal is its captain and Harbaron is its ferryman. In a time before memory, the Naglfar was the prize of Helya's fleet. It has lived on to serve her once more and, in the words of Havi, "cuts through the mist unseen by the living". The kvaldir can summon her to Azeroth using the Echoing Horn of the Damned. Nadjia the Mistblade is a venthyr and part of the Soulbinding process. She is first encountered in a cage in the Endmire in Revendreth. Her name in life was Viscountess Eak'le of Asquiron, premiere of the Order of Blades. Her sinstone describes her actions as "abhorrent." She is in charge of the venthyr guards for Sinfall and the Ember Court. She appears to be a very talented swordswoman, able to effortlessly parry blows from attacking Mawsworn while speaking casually. Nadjia appears during the Venthyr Assault, battling Mawsworn Crushers alongside a Tirnenn Grove Guardian.
